title: SITORA Evidence
description: Attributable operational evidence retaining source, provenance, time, access context, and relevance.

intentId.description: Reference to the intent this evidence pertains to.

subject.description: The entity the evidence is about (e.g., employee id, role, system).

recordType.description: Record type within the source system.

recordId.description: Native record identifier in the source system.

asOf.description: Point in time the evidence reflects (may differ from retrieval).

value.description: The evidence payload (typed per evaluation rule).

provenance.description: Access context / provenance note (e.g., 'read-only export, behind-login'). Null provenance marks evidence as not attributable (Unverifiable).
